assumptions.text: All rates are synthetic placeholders, not UP tariff rates.
Power factor is shown for information only; this tariff has no power factor charge or rebate.
Billing demand is the higher of recorded MD and 75% of contract demand, kept exact (never rounded).
Charges are per billing period and are not prorated by period length.
Each money line is rounded once, half-up to the paisa.
Demand above contract demand pays 1.5 times the demand rate, in addition to the demand charge.
Energy is billed on kVAh.
Zone kVAh comes from the meter; the three zones must add up to total kVAh. Without zone data the adjustment is MISSING, never zero.
The zone amounts are added exactly and rounded once.
Duty is 5% of the rounded demand, excess demand, energy and ToD lines; printed 'other' lines are not part of the base.
The payable total is rounded half-up to the rupee; the difference is shown as its own line.
